lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters are visible along the mid-flank. The centroids show a semi-regular staggered distribution, with larger, more intense blobs concentrated in the region immediately posterior to the pectoral fin's trailing edge.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of blobs. The most prominent high-luminance nodes occur at these intersections, forming a coarse grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two distinct longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient—bright light on the dorsal edge transitioning to deep shadow on the ventral edge—running parallel to the dorsal midline.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible silhouette of the first dorsal fin contains a sparse distribution of approximately 5-8 distinct, high-luminance circular spots, primarily localized along the leading edge and the central-distal surface area.

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive presence of elongated, low-luminance silhouettes (commensal organisms) clustered along the lower lateral flank and ventral region, partially occluding the primary integumentary pattern.
